verdict.rationale: Render's docs say you can 'connect your repo and ship with every push', and Docker support plus a community report that it is 'even easier to setup than Heroku' back the git-connected deploy flow. Nothing in the evidence shows the 'without manual build configuration' part, such as automatic detection of language, framework or build and start commands. Missing for 10: evidence of zero-config build/runtime auto-detection, in-depth docs on the repo-connect deploy flow, hands-on corroboration that no build settings are needed.
